title: 2021 Topps #3 Matt Chapman Oakland Athletics Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Topps baseball trading card featuring Matt Chapman of the Oakland Athletics. This card is part of the set released by Topps for the 2021 MLB season. It is a collectible item for fans of baseball and trading cards, showcasing a specific player from a specific team within the Major League. The card is designed and manufactured in the United States and is a sought-after item for collectors looking to add to their sports memorabilia collection.
